title: yencoding-multi: add_part silently skips whole_file_crc32 — caller must call set_expected_crc32 manually
description: add_part() does not auto-extract whole_file_crc32 from the DecodedPart. The doc comment tells callers to call set_expected_crc32(part.whole_file_crc32.unwrap()) separately. If they forget, finish() silently succeeds without any CRC check even when the CRC was present in every part. Consider auto-extracting on first non-None whole_file_crc32 seen. At minimum, add a loud warning in both the add_part and finish doc comments about the silent skip.
